entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Use `dotnetup` to install preview SDK and runtime in build scripts #52699
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/10.0.3xx` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #52693
  • [dotnet-watch] Do not watch content of directories that match file exclusions #52682
  • WASM/WASI/WASIX support for the full toolchain #52681

Closed

  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]With 11.0.0-preview.1.26069.103 SDK installed, Error NETSDK1094 happens when publish NuGetPackageExplorer(net9.0) failed using PublishReadyToRun="true" in CLI. #52565
  • Dotnet Build fails, trying to copy "files" referencing old dotnet user-secrets #30020
  • I have errors when I do MAUI on visual studio #29824
  • Using PublishSingleFile and IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract on macOS causes a "Class PlaceholderObject is implemented in both" warning #29658
  • Updating from 7.0.100 to 7.0.101 crashes msbuild on mac #30271
  • Fail to install MAUI from main branch with error "Failed to install manifest microsoft.net.workload.mono.toolchain version 6.0.13... is not found in NuGet feeds" #29462
  • Dotnet test in multiplatform docker build #29308
  • Avoid packaging patched assemblies that are part of the framework #29280
  • dotnet tool install does not include all the files in .nupkg #29262
  • Exporting generated docker file with .Net 7 publish command #29251
  • .NET 7 Android workload could not be loaded #29242
  • `dotnet build` is not working when called from a second .NET program #29117
  • Valid dotnet commands with a capital letter doesn't do anything #29109
  • NoStdLib is not beign respected after net7 upgrade #29110
  • dotnet build fails on solution that with a vcproj that references a CLR vcxproj #29088
  • running on macOS Monterey, Apple M1 Mac, extremely slow, and generating multiples dotnet processes #28925
  • Publish target should return the items published #28890
  • .NET 6: dotnet build not creating GeneratedMSBuildEditorConfig.editorconfig file? #28863
  • Latest macOS Tahoe 26.2 Release Breaks Dev-Certs #52577
  • dotnet --info broke in SDK v10.0.102 #52533
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/10.0.3xx` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #52518
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]11.0.100-preview.1.26066.111 sdk exe and zip, .NET workloads throw “System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException (0x80040154)” when run dotnet --info. #52542
  • Optimize for autonomous code-assistants #49951
    11.0.1xx

  • TODO: Limit recursive dir watching based on inclusion/exclusion globs #52692
